_about: Product carbon intensity, benchmarked against a REGIONAL optimum. Ships with ONE worked example - potatoes - on purpose: it demonstrates the idea without implying eff intends to audit every part of a client's operation. Add a product only when a client asks for it.
_calibration_warning: Values carry a 'src' key naming their source. Those marked 'est' are still planning estimates pending calibration. Even fully-sourced results are a SCREENING footprint for ranking sites and sizing opportunities — a declarable product carbon footprint requires ISO 14067 / GHG Protocol Product Standard work with verified primary data and, for any public claim, third-party verification.
_ef_about: kg CO2e per unit. Grid factor is Egypt-specific and moves with the generation mix.
_pump_about: Water becomes carbon through the energy lifting it. kWh/m3 = rho*g*H / (3.6e6 * eta); at 65% wire-to-water efficiency that is 0.0042 kWh per m3 per metre of head. This is why water-table depth is a REGIONAL factor and not a national constant.
_regions_about: Factors multiply the national ideal for inputs tagged with the matching climate driver. Derived from mean temperature, typical water-table depth and cooling/heating degree days — replace with local data as it is gathered.
_products_about: ideal = best practice achievable in the Delta reference region. typical = what an unoptimised operation runs at. climate tags the regional factor that scales the ideal.

standards._note: The methodology frame this model follows in structure, without claiming conformity.
standards.iso_14067: ISO 14067:2018 — Carbon footprint of products: quantification and communication. The international reference standard for PCF.
standards.ghg_protocol_product: GHG Protocol Product Life Cycle Accounting and Reporting Standard.
standards.pas_2050: PAS 2050 (BSI, 2008) — the first PCF standard; more prescriptive than ISO 14067.
standards.iso_14064: ISO 14064 — organisation-level GHG quantification, the frame for any credit certification.
standards.water: Mekonnen & Hoekstra (2011), UNESCO-IHE Report 47 — green/blue/grey water footprint of crops.

sources.mh2011: Mekonnen & Hoekstra (2011), Water Footprint of Crops, UNESCO-IHE Report 47 — potato global average 287 m3/t (green+blue+grey).
sources.fao_cropwat: FAO Irrigation & Drainage Paper 24/56 — potato seasonal crop water requirement 500-700 mm; applied volume derived at 70% (surface) to 90% (drip) efficiency.
sources.lca_potato_range: Published potato LCAs, farm gate: NL table 77 and 97, CN 172 (CI 139-213), CY spring 147 / winter 241 kg CO2e per tonne.
sources.ncc_fcr: Feed conversion ratio for modern broilers approx. 1.5 kg feed per kg live weight (industry LCA literature, 2018-2020).
sources.lca_broiler_range: Published broiler LCAs: 3.3-4.6 kg CO2e per kg live weight (farm gate). Cradle-to-grave retail figures are far higher and not comparable.
sources.est: eff planning estimate — NOT yet sourced. Calibrate from client data.
sources.lca_feed_ingredients: Feed ingredient LCAs: maize 0.39-0.81 and soybean 0.39-1.7 kg CO2e/kg; feed production is 60-80% of poultry GHG. Composite for a maize/soy broiler ration.
